scope: Plaintext nonempty responses on an OSCORE session whose token no pending protected request used

standard.name: IETF OSCORE
standard.summary: A client does not let unprotected responses drive application behavior; only a response correlated with its request is processed for that request

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defect.observed: A plaintext 2.05 with a token no request had used, relayed before the genuine protected response, ended the active protected GET with security_handshake_failed
defect.cause: The response-admission patch raised COAP_EVENT_OSCORE_NO_PROTECTED_PAYLOAD for every plaintext nonempty response on an OSCORE session before token correlation, and the worker ends a pending request on that event

assertions: Patch 0010 raises the missing-protection event only when an OSCORE request association exists for the response token and otherwise discards the plaintext response
The same-stack relay case injects an OSCORE-optioned 2.05 and a plaintext 2.05, each with an unused token, before the genuine response; the protected GET returns the libcoap root resource
Against the preceding helper the relay case returns security_handshake_failed
A protection-vector variant sends a plaintext response with an unused token and requires no delivery and no protection event; it fails against the nine-patch SDK
The fifteen correlated plaintext GET/POST/PUT variants still report exactly one protection failure and no application value each

lanes.command: WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3 mix wotex.software.build --workspace "$ABSOLUTE_EMPTY_WORKSPACE"; then mix wotex.software.run with the same OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR
docker build -f Dockerfile -t wotex-coap-agent-native:plaintext CONTEXT (native/oscore sources, patches, yyjson, test/native sources and the pinned archive as source.tar.gz)

unaccepted: A plaintext response whose token matches a pending request still ends that request with security_handshake_failed, by design
